# Overview of MicroDuck Task Demonstration

Here, it is presented according to tasks. GPU inference occurs first, followed by BPU inference. Click on an expanded item to view more versions; for training, model sources, and implementation steps, please refer to the task tutorials.

The GPU performs calculations on the workstation; the BPU performs calculations on the RDK X5, while the workstation is responsible for simulation and image rendering. The web page displays saved task videos; to rerun the steps, refer to [ Notebook explanation ](../../03-Notebook/README.md).

## Ladder Climbing and Desk Ascending

## Materials and Reproduction

- All submitted video previews are in GIF format; the MP4 files in Notebook outputs have been replaced by relative GIF links.
- The original MP4 files remain on the simulation workstation to reduce cloning and browsing overhead. The environment, model, metrics, and reproduction steps for each task are provided in the corresponding task README.
- Running the Notebook generates new task MP4 files and evaluation reports.
